purpose: Availability screening of two independent non-Payy application families
selection_criteria: Pinned publicly retrievable producer and Solidity consumer sources with usable license evidence
Source-traceable public-input construction, decoding, verifier call and protected effects
Primary policy documentation separate from assumed implementation correctness
A documented or source-supported honest local proving and replay route, with unresolved prerequisites explicit
Independent application lineage from Payy, with shared cryptographic dependencies and prior exposure disclosed
scope_gate: Report Noir/ACIR, batching, external-call and initialization fit separately. No frontend or threat-model expansion is authorized. A conditional fallback is not an initial-scope selection.
outcomes: Select a plausible target with all qualifications stated, or retain an unresolved selection gate. No security verdict follows; research verdict remains UNKNOWN.
exposure: Candidate discovery has read public search snippets, the official awesome-noir list, and repository metadata for these two families plus Railgun-Privacy/contract. No pinned candidate circuit or consumer source has yet been inspected. Prior conversation includes general ZK/Payy literature exposure; no claim of complete blindness.
holdout_rule: Availability/source correspondence inspection is disclosed exposure. Do not tune an analyzer, inspect defect labels or create mutations here; freeze later mechanism and policy procedure before transfer evaluation. Retire a case as held-out if later results guide rule changes.
preservation: D1-00 and D1-01 archives, D1-01 seal and its nine deliverables, all completed reports and historical scripts are immutable. New raw output only under results/raw/D1-02. No stage, commit, push, external contact or delegation.
